# PECO CAP public source fixture

`peco-cap-2026.pdf` is the unchanged public two-page PECO CAP application, retrieved October 26, 2026 EDT (October 27 01:15 UTC).

- Source: https://www.peco.com/cdn/assets/v3/assets/blt1b5616c79bacadb4/blt9d4fc50508d00567/69f41a34626de91f304d9b8f/PECO_CAP_Application_2026_v2.pdf?branch=prod_alias
- SHA-256: `87d4a25f808eac9e79eaf49197bb38c1e375d22b18ce0533995eca81698099cc`
- Size: 269,140 bytes; two US Letter pages.

The source has 48 page widgets but only three canonical fields, including duplicate/overlapping City and Cell Phone widgets. The rehearsal renderer deliberately produces a static **unsigned preparation draft**, preserving the two printed pages and their mail link. It does not repair the field tree, invent a signature, supply optional SSNs/ITINs, assemble income evidence, submit anything, or establish provider acceptance.

The original pages are embedded at 94% scale with translation `(18.36, 32)` onto fresh Letter pages. This creates separate bands for the visible draft banner and applicant/account identity on every page without covering source text. Household continuation pages preserve people beyond the five printed rows. All test household data is synthetic.

This rehearsal permits unknown home/cell phone values to remain blank; that is not evidence that the provider waives requested contact information. It requires each supplied household member's income source and rejects the conditional `LIHEAP Data Sharing` exemption because this input does not establish the prerequisite PECO selection and DHS income-sharing authorization. Income evidence, completeness, signature acceptance and provider receipt still require separate operational proof.
